flows._WNote: startAt was wound back from 2026-10-24T18:30:00Z (midnight IST the day it went live) to midnight IST 21 Oct on 2026-10-25, so the four days of signups who were already waiting could be backfilled. It has to live HERE and not just in the backfill script: the worker re-checks eligibility against the DEPLOYED value and records before-start as a TERMINAL outcome, so a backfill reaching past it destroys each offer instead of sending it. Leaving it wound back is harmless day to day, because each scheduled run only ever looks at yesterday.

context._replaceModeNote: live since 2026-10-23, the day the payload was proven. context._emailNote: EMAIL_FROM also narrows the worker's ses:SendEmail to that exact address (stack.js): a domain identity otherwise authorises EVERY address at morpaankh.in, and the shop's real mailbox is on that same domain. Reply-To is the gmail because the MX for morpaankh.in points at GoDaddy and hello@ has no mailbox.
context._subscriberOfferAllowlistNote: LIVE since 2026-10-25. EMPTY means every candidate is really messaged. It was a soak allowlist for one day; the owner asked for the flow on, so it was cleared. NON-EMPTY puts it back into shadow instantly (every other candidate is logged as 'subscriber: would send' with nothing created, sent or locked), which is the gentler kill switch than disabling the flow outright. It accepts an address as well as a number, because matching on phone alone meant the email channel could never be soaked at all.
